cells.gaps: DJI-001 (7 Oct 2025) records the elaboration of a national digital strategy as a challenge still open, but systems.csv shows later mentions of a Smart Nation strategy, a 'stratégie numérique' presented at WSIS 2026 and a decision to update the Smart Nation Strategy (World Bank, 10 Feb 2026), none described or dated as adopted, drafting or launched, so absence cannot be claimed as stage 1 and no rung above is set. Other national instruments (AI strategy, Digital Code, Vision 2035) are thematic, directive or development-plan and set nothing.
cells.note: No instrument on record is described as adopted, announced or in preparation, and the one statement of absence is contradicted by later undescribed mentions of a national strategy. Unplaced rather than stage 1.
